tasks.original_prompt:
Who is this patient's lab follow-up booked with, and is insurance in force for that day? If not, alert that clinician about the appointment; otherwise change nothing.
Context: patient MRN SYN-8c857cd627 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2026-04-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date; its clinician is the Practitioner of the PractitionerRole among its participants. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "clinician": ..., "alerted": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and clinician (string: that Practitioner's name text, or its given names and family name joined by spaces). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinician with that Practitioner and $appointment with the lab visit: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinician"}], "about": [{"reference": "$appointment"}]}. alerted (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the PractitionerRole and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; call its start date the visit date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "new_results": [...], "new_orders": [...]}. new_results has one entry for every Observation with status final or corrected, a code.coding code in this list: 718-7, 4548-4, 2160-0, 3016-3, 35200-5, 35217-9, and an effective date after the visit date and on or before the as-of date, sorted by date then code, each with exactly these keys: code (string), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). new_orders has one entry for every ServiceRequest authored after the visit date and on or before the as-of date, sorted by ordered then code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: first code.coding code), ordered (string: authoredOn date, YYYY-MM-DD) and status (string). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Encounter, each listed Observation and each listed ServiceRequest), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

Use null for any value the chart does not have.
